headline: The D2 report is emitted when the 14-byte input payload CHANGES. 0x1e0dad2 does a library memcmp of the current input state against the previous payload and skips the report when they are equal; when they differ it snapshots 28 bytes and arms a 100-iteration repeat counter.

trigger_path.role: entry thunk (34 bytes, NO in-image caller) - a tbb selector on the low nibble of r0 that calls 0x1e0f154 for the general arm
trigger_path.note: no in-image caller means it is registered with / invoked by the library - the event source is outside the app image

trigger_path.role: mid layer (4964 bytes, strings ' %x err=%d', ' switch mode')
the real container of the D2 emitter (990 bytes) - the periodic/tick body
evidence: 1e0ac32/1e0ac38: drains a queue and calls the A5 dispatcher 0x1e08772 with r1 = [r9+0x98], r2 = h[r9+0x9c]
1e0ac42/1e0ac58: call 0x1fbbba (tick), r0 -= [r9+0x14], if (r0 < 0x1f5) skip the periodic section - a 501-tick gate

trigger_path.role: sets state+0x1b4 = 2 and clears state+0x1b4+0x8/+0xc and state+0x17

evidence: 1e0dac2: r4 = r12 + 0x8c (r12 = 0x4e40, so the input state lives at 0x4ecc)
1e0dad2: if (r0 == 0x0) goto 0x1e0db1c  <-- equal means NO new report

d2_send_if.expression: emit(A5 12 02, 14-byte payload)  IFF  b[state+0x10] != 0  AND  memcmp(state14 @ 0x4ecc, previous14) != 0
d2_send_if.repeat: after a detected change the counter b[state+0x3a] = 100 is decremented in the loop 0x1e0db1c-0x1e0db32 and the report is re-sent while it is nonzero; the unchanged path jumps straight into that same counter logic
d2_send_if.periodic_gate: the enclosing tick body additionally requires (tick - [state+0x18c]) >= h[r9+0x12] before touching the report block
d2_send_if.unit: the 0x1f5 threshold at 0x1e0ac58 and the r9+0x12 interval are tick counts of the 0x1fbbba tick source - NO time unit is claimed

zero_idle_explanation.proven_mechanism: the report is not free-running: 0x1e0dad2 compares the current 14-byte input state with the last one and skips when equal. Idle therefore produces no frames even with D2 enabled.

rt_no_self_trigger.why: the compared region is 14 bytes = mask u32 + 4 axes + LT + RT, so an RT analogue change would make the memcmp differ and would trip the very gate that fires reports. That conflicts with the live observation that RT-only movement emits nothing.
rt_no_self_trigger.resolution_hypothesis_to_test: the RT byte at 0x4ecc+0x0e may only be refreshed under a digital-event condition, or the compared buffer may be a filtered state rather than the raw axes. Not proven - do not report RT as explained.
rt_no_self_trigger.next: find every writer of 0x4ecc+0x0e and 0x4ecc+0x04..+0x0c and check whether the RT byte is updated unconditionally.

state_0x1b4_meaning.conclusion: a MODE/STATE selector with at least two values, not a dirty flag. The earlier 'dirty' terminology is retired for this field.
state_0x1b4_meaning.reader: 0x1e06842 ORs it with state+0x1c4 and early-outs when nonzero
